instruction: A standing stag drawn purely as glowing tube edges, its polygonal body a lattice of hot magenta lines with cyan accents tracing the spine and legs. The antlers branch into a dense cage of luminous filaments that flare brighter at every vertex node, and the interior is empty dark space so the silhouette reads as pure light. A faint bloom halo surrounds each tube against the black.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Neon Wireframe Stag in a neon-wireframe style. A standing stag drawn purely as glowing tube edges, its polygonal body a lattice of hot magenta lines with cyan accents tracing the spine and legs. The antlers branch into a dense cage of luminous filaments that flare brighter at every vertex node, and the interior is empty dark space so the silhouette reads as pure light. A faint bloom halo surrounds each tube against the black. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
